name: sim_cvc5_game_semantics_hyland_ong
description: Hyland-Ong game semantics: alternation constraint via cvc5 SMT, strategy counting via sympy

pytorch.reason: pytorch not needed; pure symbolic/algebraic computation via cvc5 and sympy

pyg.reason: PyG message passing not needed; game semantics handled via SMT solver

z3.reason: z3 not needed; cvc5 handles all SMT constraint proofs in this sim

cvc5.reason: cvc5 SMT solver: load_bearing proof of game semantics constraints

sympy.reason: sympy: supportive symbolic algebra for strategy counting formulas

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed; game logic constraints only

geomstats.reason: geomstats not needed; no differential geometry in this sim

e3nn.reason: e3nn not needed; no SO(3) equivariance required

rustworkx.reason: rustworkx not needed; no graph structure in this sim

xgi.reason: xgi not needed; pairwise interactions only

toponetx.reason: toponetx not needed; standard algebraic ops sufficient

gudhi.reason: gudhi not needed; no persistent homology in this sim

test_simple_alternation_O_P.interpretation: O move followed by P move satisfies alternation

test_consecutive_O_moves.interpretation: Two consecutive O-moves violates alternation (should be UNSAT)

test_invalid_sequence.interpretation: Sequence with two consecutive O-moves violates alternation
